method: reviewed exact-part pin types applied only to isolated native KiCad copies; original and typed XML memberships must be identical; native ERC findings retained without suppression

source_review_findings.finding: Static ERC cannot establish charging/OTG/backup direction or startup rail availability.
Grounded ACDRV1/2 are explicitly permitted without input FETs; require configuration-specific exception.
Bootstrap power_in is capacitor-fed, not an independent DC rail.
Regulated rail exists after the external LC network, not directly at SW.
BST table type O conflicts with description 'supply input'; power_in reflects capacitor-fed driver semantics, not a DC source.
VCC must not be treated as an externally driven VIN input.
H2 aon_buck.FB_VSET is intentionally open: 42.2kohm MODE resistor selects VSET; open VSET selects 3.3V (Tables8-1/8-2).
Materialized wide lands20/23/32/34 represent manufacturer pin groups20-22/23-25/32-33/34-35; no missing-land inference.
H2 PP5V grounded and GPIOs grounded require verified sink-only configuration; do not infer power readiness from passive power-path pins.
I2Ct_IRQ type assumes IRQ function; final GPIO/PD configuration must be checked.
H2 direct QOD-to-VOUT ties are explicitly allowed; passive models resistive switched discharge without false output contention.
Pad25 materialized EP_GND requires explicit manufacturer exposed-pad electrical tie verification; intentionally unreviewed and omitted.
ALRT role depends on OvrdEn; H2 uses PACK_FET_OVERRIDE_N. Verify programmed override mode.
PFAIL output subtype and PCKP pulldown behavior require richer electrical modeling if conflict rules depend on output impedance.
Materialized pad9 thermal-metal/common-drain assignment requires explicit electrical verification beyond numbered terminal table; intentionally unreviewed and omitted.
FET channel/body-diode connectivity needs graph modeling; passive does not establish an enabled power source.

Manufacturer table defines MISO/IRQ as outputs but does not prove MISO deselected high-Z behavior or IRQ open-drain topology at module level. Keep output classification until the module implementation/underlying nRF24L01+ interface is cross-checked; do not permit shared push-pull IRQ wiring by assumption.

Pad19 is an internal PSRAM chip-select output, not a free GPIO or a physically absent connection. Exact N8R8 endpoint policy must require no external connection. ANT2 pad31 is disabled by default; bidirectional capability does not authorize changing the populated antenna path.

Pad28/29/30 actual internal PSRAM connections are not electrically NC; exact N16R8 board-use policy must still require no external connections. Broad GPIO bidirectional types do not authorize use of reserved pins or prove boot strap levels.

Manufacturer-hosted current Rev17 product-brief retrieval failed (502/connection refused); types use Everest-authored Rev10 datasheet and Rev1.11 user guide mirrored by Waveshare. Reconcile against current manufacturer revision before production acceptance.

Pads14 DACVREF, 15 ADCVREF and 16 VMID are omitted from pins: the primary table labels these capacitor-only analog references Analog/filtering capacitor connection without an ERC direction. Do not count them as verified passive pins or infer that they can supply external loads.
Current codec.MCLK is deliberate NC; register0x01[7] can select BCLK. Correct BCLK-derived configuration and timing remain a separate firmware/electrical obligation, not proven by this pin map.
SCLK and LRCK need current slave-mode endpoint overrides before detecting host-output conflicts; broad bidirectional device capability is not a chosen operating mode.

Pad31 XOUT is omitted from pins because its ERC direction is unresolved. The manufacturer table calls both crystal terminals Analogue(XOSC); evaluate a dedicated oscillator-pair rule rather than count a passive placeholder as verified coverage.
Endpoint policy must preserve actual QSPI bus electrical capability while forbidding unwanted external loads; broad QSPI_* no-connect matching must never capture the supply.
Power reachability must model VREG_LX through its inductor only when VREG_VIN and VREG_AVDD are supplied; a power_out label alone does not prove a powered core.

Pins1 LOUT/DFS, 2 GPO3/DCLK and 3 GPO2/INTB are omitted from pins. The public manufacturer data short confirms assignments and basic functions, but not complete mode-dependent directions: digital-audio/oscillator behavior on 1/2 and output versus open-drain/tri-state topology on 3 require exact evidence. These three pins are not verified electrical coverage.

Pin13 RCLK as crystal oscillator input requires paired-pin and mode constraints; pin9 reset can configure multiplexed pad behavior. Full exact Si4732-A10 documentation is still required before ERC acceptance.
PA1/NRST, PA19/SWDIO and PA20/SWCLK are GPIO-capable at device level. Current safety/reset/debug configuration must narrow direction separately; map does not prove safe boot configuration.

Pin 4 FLTR is the external compensation-capacitor terminal to V_UP. Its function is verified, but a simple input/output electrical direction is not established; it is deliberately omitted from reviewed pins rather than marked passive as a placeholder.
Detector feedback, filter stability, ADC range, RF loading and disabled-state behavior remain outside this pin-type review.
Control-state complementarity, control voltage, RF-port DC isolation and matched transmission-line behavior are not established by passive RF-terminal typing.
Open-collector typing does not prove the analog output load/bias path: both output collectors require the reviewed transformer/inductor or resistor feed, valid common-mode voltage and current limits.
Mixer input bias return, LO level, matching and frequency conversion remain separate analog checks.
Gain/offset feedback, output/ADC loading and RF input DC blocking need circuit-level verification.

Pad 3 has simultaneous analog-output and power-input roles; a single KiCad pin type cannot express both. Verify the DC feed through the bias choke and RF output/DC block separately; this pin must never be treated as a self-powered power_out.
This pin review is not proof of LNA stability, matching, gain, noise figure, bias current or thermal adequacy.
Switch control sequencing, supply state, RF power/DC limits and routing/matching remain circuit-level obligations.
Input common-mode/differential limits, hysteresis, pull-up rail and current must be checked in the actual powered and unpowered circuit.

Output pull-up, input range, hysteresis and POR timing require configuration-aware review. The datasheet permits unused open-drain outputs to float or connect to V-, but that is not a general permission for arbitrary output ties.

Check pull-ups and each channel's actual thresholds/input polarity and POR state. Wired output combinations require deliberate open-drain logic; this type alone does not validate the resulting logic function.
Feedback sign, gain, bandwidth, capacitive-load stability, common-mode range and output swing are not proven by input/output pin typing.

The exact U-DFN3030-8E has a central exposed pad, shown without a pin number or electrical assignment in DS41333. Current RF U86 speaker_amp footprint has an unnumbered 1.60x2.35-mm copper/paste pad; H2 materialization excludes it from electrical contacts. Its permitted electrical connection and thermal implementation need exact manufacturer/package evidence. Do not invent pad9=GND or count this unnumbered pad as electrically verified.
BTL load connection, shutdown level, supply filtering, output EMI and dissipation require circuit/layout verification.
Conduction and level-shifting behavior require circuit-level review; passive D/S types do not imply a permanently connected path.
A MOSFET channel is not an independent power source; gate bias and body-diode orientation require circuit-level review.
ERC cannot establish transistor bias, gain or whether a particular instance operates as an open-collector stage.
NC6/7/9/10 are not internal pass-through connections or additional protected channels; permitted routing connections must not be mistaken for internal continuity.
Pad3 VBIAS is omitted: primary pin table specifies an ESD-support capacitor terminal but does not establish its source/sink direction; needs further primary circuit evidence before typing.
Protected CC/SBU continuity, dead-battery pull-down configuration and allowed fault conditions are not established by static ERC.
Pin typing does not verify watchdog timeout selection, startup sequencing or fault-response logic.
Clamp voltage, surge current and external source impedance require circuit-level checks, not static ERC.
Static ERC does not prove selected-path continuity, USB direction or safe switching sequence.
Static ERC does not establish conditional analog-path continuity or permitted signal range.
Static ERC does not establish conditional switch continuity or powered-off isolation.
Manufacturer A/B caption and physical lever direction must be reconciled before directional RUN/KILL silkscreen is accepted; electrical shorted pairs are unambiguous.

SJ121836/SJ121837 full exact contact drawing was not obtained in this review. A5/A6/A7/A8/B5/B6/B7/B8 and SH are deliberately omitted from verified pins; do not infer their full physical mapping from USB family convention or another manufacturer's receptacle.

The inspected controlled sheet establishes 80 identical passive contacts and the polarization mark but does not explicitly enumerate all pin numbers or a plug-to-receptacle numbering table. Native 1..80 labels are a CAD convention here; full M1 mating-order proof remains in the board-to-board interface/geometry contract, not established by this type map alone.

The inspected controlled sheet establishes 80 identical passive contacts and the polarization mark but does not explicitly enumerate all pin numbers or a plug-to-receptacle numbering table. Native 1..80 labels are a CAD convention here; full M1 mating-order proof remains in the board-to-board interface/geometry contract, not established by this type map alone.

Exact controlled drawing could not be visually re-opened: GCT download returned HTTP403, and a prior local .pdf was HTML rather than PDF. Connector passive function is established by the manufacturer product; native 1..5 launch/shell aliases still need an independent exact drawing-to-footprint positional crosscheck. Do not treat this entry as a released landing-pattern audit.

Exact controlled drawing could not be visually re-opened: GCT download returned HTTP403, and a prior local .pdf was HTML rather than PDF. Connector passive function is established by the manufacturer product; native 1..5 launch/shell aliases still need an independent exact drawing-to-footprint positional crosscheck. Do not treat this entry as a released landing-pattern audit.

The catalog proves the four physical holder contacts but does not legibly establish the exact polarized 1048P slot-to-pad plus/minus assignment. Do not promote current SLOT0_POS/SLOT1_POS labels to independently verified polarity until the exact 1048P drawing or a sufficiently clear manufacturer photo is checked. Cells and system wiring, not the bare holder, establish supply-source semantics.

The switch is a symmetric isolated D/E pair; current H2 D->S1/E->S2 aliases were not accepted as manufacturer-position proof in this pass. Final D/E-to-native-S1/S2 positional review is separate from the verified passive push-switch type.

The manufacturer establishes signal directions but does not publish complete DC VIH/VIL/VOH/VOL or output-stage topology for these module pins. Generic output typing is not proof of push-pull construction or compatibility with the VVOICE_IO_3V3 TMUX/RP2354 domain at every supply/state.

Before PD is driven low, RXD must already be low. The R141 pull-down does not override an actively high selected UART transmitter; normal sleep, deselection and fault-driven shutdown sequences still require explicit verification.

H/L must remain low or floating. Shared open-drain connectivity is observed, but this pin map does not prove inter-module leakage limits, high-power selection, one-hot PD/PTT behavior, supply margins or RF/thermal performance.
The module-pin DC levels and output-stage topology are not fully characterized by the published specification; the same voltage-domain caveat as U39 remains for U51.
RXD-low-before-PD sequencing must also be proved for the VHF module, including deselection and fault-driven shutdown; R146 alone cannot force a live UART driver low.
Common pin numbering does not prove VHF RF matching, TX power, one-hot control, leakage, supply/current margins or thermal performance.

This map does not prove the programmed PD EEPROM image, TPS25751 boot/read/write sequence, GPIO0 configuration, power-up timing or I2C timing margins. The memory's shipped erased state is not a usable PD configuration image.

WP pull-up versus the internal pull-down, actual voltage corners and behavior while the PD rail is absent require their existing state/corner checks; generic input/bidirectional pin types do not clear those obligations.
